csv_project_name: Engineering For MD 170 Norcross Ln to Wieker Rd Improvements
csv_agency: State of Maryland Department of Transportation
csv_scope_of_work: MDOT SHA may be seeking a consultant to provide a engineering services for MD 170 Norcross Ln to Wieker Rd Improvements - This project will provide additional northbound and southbound through lanes along MD 170 from Norcross Lane to Wieker Road, and a raised median to control left turn movements. This project also includes bicycle and pedestrian improvements, stormwater management facilities, road resurfacing, installation of traffic signs and pavement markings, traffic signal reconstruction, and landscaping.
